async def act(page):
    # No helper functions are available in the knowledge base for this task.
    # We are starting from the pages listing. Locate the row for the "About Us" page
    # by filtering rows that have a cell with the title text "About Us" and click the
    # title cell to open the edit form.

    # Find the row that has the About Us cell
    row_locator = page.get_by_role("row").filter(has=page.get_by_role("cell", name="About Us"))
    if await row_locator.count() == 0:
        # Try alternate capitalization just in case
        row_locator = page.get_by_role("row").filter(has=page.get_by_role("cell", name="About us"))

    if await row_locator.count() == 0:
        raise Exception('Could not find the row for the "About Us" page in the pages listing')

    # Click the "About Us" cell within that row to open the edit page
    about_cell = row_locator.first.get_by_role("cell", name="About Us")
    if await about_cell.count() == 0:
        about_cell = row_locator.first.get_by_role("cell", name="About us")

    if await about_cell.count() == 0:
        raise Exception('Could not find the title cell for the "About Us" page')

    # Click to open the edit page (this is expected to navigate)
    await about_cell.first.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Now on the edit page: locate the title textbox. Try several likely accessible names.
    title_field = None
    for label in ("Page Title", "Title", "Page title"):
        candidate = page.get_by_role("textbox", name=label)
        if await candidate.count() > 0:
            title_field = candidate.first
            break

    # If not found by named labels, if exactly one textbox exists, assume it's the title
    if title_field is None:
        any_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox")
        if await any_textbox.count() == 1:
            title_field = any_textbox.first

    if title_field is None:
        raise Exception('Could not locate the page title field on the edit form')

    # Fill the new title
    await title_field.fill("Secret")

    # Locate the Save button. Try common accessible names and fallbacks.
    save_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save Page")
    if await save_button.count() == 0:
        save_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save")

    if await save_button.count() == 0:
        # Fallback: find any button that contains the text "Save"
        save_button = page.get_by_role("button").filter(has_text="Save")

    if await save_button.count() == 0:
        raise Exception('Could not locate a Save button to persist the About Us page title change')

    # Click Save (this is expected to navigate away / persist changes) and finish
    await save_button.first.click()
